about.label: About Maria
about.title: Your Trusted Florida Realtor
about.body: Maria Cardona is a trilingual real estate professional — fluent in English, Spanish, and Portuguese — with 8 years of experience serving buyers, sellers, and investors across Orlando, Kissimmee, Davenport, and Central Florida.

about_page.bio1: Maria Cardona is a licensed Florida Realtor and trilingual real estate professional fluent in English, Spanish, and Portuguese — with 8 years of experience in the Central Florida market, including Orlando, Kissimmee, Davenport, and Champions Gate.
about_page.bio2: Her multilingual background offers a unique advantage in Florida's diverse market, allowing her to serve clients from all backgrounds with clarity and genuine understanding. Whether you're relocating internationally, purchasing your first home, or strategically investing, Maria provides seamless transactions and expert guidance at every step.
about_page.bio3: Her approach is built on transparency, ethics, and real results — not just closing deals, but building lasting relationships with the families she serves.

buy_steps.step1_desc: We start with a no-obligation conversation to understand your needs, goals, and budget.
buy_steps.step2_desc: I curate a personalized list of properties that match your criteria and schedule viewings.
buy_steps.step3_desc: Once you find the right home, I help you craft a competitive offer and negotiate on your behalf.
buy_steps.step4_desc: I coordinate inspections and guide you through every detail to protect your investment.
buy_steps.step5_desc: I walk you through every document and make sure your closing day is smooth and stress-free.

sell_steps.step1_desc: Get a comprehensive market analysis of your property to determine the optimal listing price.
sell_steps.step2_desc: Staging advice, professional photography, and preparation tips to maximize your home's appeal.
sell_steps.step3_desc: Your home is listed on MLS, featured on social media, and marketed to qualified buyers.
sell_steps.step4_desc: I coordinate all showings and carefully review every offer to get you the best terms.
sell_steps.step5_desc: Expert negotiation on your behalf and full support through every step of closing.
